advisory_en: CHIRAG DELHI: flood probability 74% — risk level HIGH. Flagged at this risk level since 05:30 IST. About 71,640 residents are in the exposed area, with 6 hospital(s), 7 school(s) and 46.9 km of road. Main drivers: near an underpass, rainfall today, dense built-up. 1 pump(s) are mapped in this ward.

actions: Deploy the 1 mapped pump(s) to the lowest points of CHIRAG DELHI
